name: sheikh-zayed-grand-mosque
description: White marble main prayer range west of a large open floral-inlaid sahn; three dominant domes, onion secondary domes, pierced colonnades and four square/octagonal/circular minarets.
attribution: Survey plans © OpenStreetMap contributors, via Protomaps, ODbL 1.0. Architectural geometry originally authored for Vearth.

audit.dimension_uncertainty: 42 primary/secondary dome centers are mapped in the source. Forty small roof dome centers interpolate roof gaps to preserve the published 82 total; small dome heights, exact floral motifs and colonnade ornaments are interpretations. The retained dense terrain survey selects six open southern-sahn samples for the median floor datum; roof-contaminated center elevation is not used. The 52-step eastern approach follows OSM way 167776873 inside mapped pedestrian area 391867933. Basin cuts preserve source water. Minaret centers use four mapped tower footprints, whose 104m tags yield to the official 107m dimension. Pool surfaces are capped 0.65m below the modeled podium and beds 1.85m below it: the 0.50m shallow basin depth is an exterior visual estimate, not a published measurement. Ten retained OSM perimeter pond rings constrain native-water correction; the two small western service ponds remain unmodified. The mapped entrance pedestrian polygon is extended 8m into the gallery to cover the survey seam. The renderer enforces a 1.2m minimum inland depth; the −1.85m bed cut therefore allows collision/rendering clearance beneath the −0.65m water surface rather than asserting the actual architectural basin depth. Immediate perimeter grading is lower-only: a rounded gallery/pool envelope grades across mapped walks/gardens toward an 8m outer cap supported by retained open-ground samples; it removes roof/tree DSM peaks while preserving lower terrain and all source features.
audit.orientation: Source footprints in east/north metric coordinates; all component rotations baked into vertices.
audit.grounding: Fixed production sampled datum with narrow lower-only cuts under authored masonry; no whole-site terrain flattening.
audit.approach_grounding: Independent bounded apron grades repair source terrain discontinuities while retaining fixed architectural floors; measured context, inferred transition extents and controls are recorded in setting-ground-calibrations.json.

geometry: original metric geometry authored for Low Poly Earth from cited architectural references
